versions.godot_export_templates: 4.7.1.stable — WEB ONLY, ios.zip and android templates absent

verification_at_close.no_floats_lint: pass — and proven to fail on a planted f32
verification_at_close.grey_cube_on_desktop: pass — verified by PNG render, origin unprojects to (960,540)
verification_at_close.grey_cube_on_device: NOT ATTEMPTED — blocked on export templates

open_blockers.detail: export_templates/4.7.1.stable/ contains only the eight web_*.zip files. ios.zip and the Android templates are absent, so both phone exports fail immediately. ~1GB download. Editor > Manage Export Templates > Download and Install, or the curl command in docs/ENVIRONMENT.md.
No signing certificate or provisioning profile, and no self-hosted macOS runner. GitHub-hosted runners cannot hold signing material safely. Needs the owner's Apple ID.
Android SDK and Java not installed. Godot reports missing platform-tools and build-tools. Owner will install manually and report back; command in docs/ENVIRONMENT.md.

open_blockers.blocks: any future brew install, including the Android toolchain
open_blockers.detail: /usr/local/bin is root-owned so Homebrew cannot symlink. Fix: sudo chown -R $(whoami) /usr/local/bin

open_decisions.detail: Nine proposed hex values in docs/ART_BIBLE.md, deliberately unlocked. Needs owner sign-off plus a colourblind check and a phone-size test render.
'Wastemarch' is a working title. Needs USPTO/EUIPO and app-store searches before any public listing.
